name: chatpod ai
author: chatpod ai

sections.description:
chatpod ai is an AI agent built for WooCommerce that helps your store sell more, support faster, and capture leads automatically.

Product Discovery & Sales

Your customers can search, browse, and buy products directly inside the chat widget. chatpod ai understands natural language queries, shows relevant products with variants, and lets shoppers add items to their WooCommerce cart without leaving the conversation.

Customer Support

chatpod ai answers questions about orders, shipping, returns, and store policies using your store’s actual data. When it can’t resolve an issue, it automatically creates a support ticket for your team.

Lead Capture & Scheduling

Qualify leads through natural conversation, book appointments via integrated calendar, and sync everything to your CRM.

Key Features

  • AI chat widget embedded on your store
  • In-chat product search and cart management
  • Real-time WooCommerce cart integration (add, update, remove items)
  • Order status tracking and notifications
  • WhatsApp channel support
  • Email marketing automations (abandoned cart, post-purchase, welcome series, win-back)
  • Custom agent persona and branded tone
  • Configurable store rules and policies
  • Support ticket escalation

How It Works

  1. Install the plugin and enter your chatpod ai secret key
  2. The plugin embeds the chatpod ai widget on every page of your store
  3. Customers interact with your AI agent to find products, get support, and complete purchases

External Services

This plugin connects to the chatpod ai platform to provide AI chat functionality. The following external services are used:

chatpod ai Backend API

  • Service: chatpod ai API (https://api.chatpod-ai.com)
  • Purpose: Fetches widget configuration, processes AI chat conversations, logs cart events, and handles automation webhooks (order events, status changes)
  • Data sent: Store URL, cart operations, order details (email, items, totals), WooCommerce session IDs
  • When: On every page load (widget config), on cart operations, and on WooCommerce order/status events
  • Terms of Service: https://chatpod-ai.com/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://chatpod-ai.com/privacy

chatpod ai Widget (CDN)

  • Service: chatpod ai CDN (https://chatpod-ai.b-cdn.net)
  • Purpose: Serves the chat widget JavaScript (loader and widget UI)
  • Data sent: None (static asset download only)
  • When: On every front-end page load

Analytics

  • Service: Mixpanel (https://cdn.mxpnl.com)
  • Purpose: Collects anonymous widget usage metrics (e.g. widget opens, searches) to power analytics in your chatpod ai dashboard
  • Data sent: Widget usage events
  • When: When the chat widget is loaded on front-end pages
  • Privacy Policy: https://mixpanel.com/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the chatpod-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress plugin screen
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu
  3. Go to Settings > chatpod ai and enter your secret key (starts with cpd_sk_)
  4. The chat widget will appear on your store automatically

Requirements

  • A chatpod ai account — sign up at chatpod-ai.com
  • WooCommerce 5.0 or later (optional — required only for cart, order, and automation features)
sections.faq:
Do I need a chatpod ai account?

Yes. The plugin connects your WooCommerce store to the chatpod ai platform, which provides the AI agent. Sign up at chatpod-ai.com.

Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

The chat widget itself will load on any WordPress site, so chatpod ai can still serve as a conversational assistant for service-based businesses. However, e-commerce features — cart integration, product search, order tracking, discount rules, and marketing automations — require WooCommerce to be installed and active.

Can I customize the widget appearance?

Yes. You can adjust the bubble position (horizontal and vertical offset) from the plugin settings page. Colors, avatar, and welcome messages are configured in your chatpod ai dashboard.

What data is sent to chatpod ai?

Cart operations, order details, and store URL are sent to the chatpod ai backend for AI processing and automation. See the “External Services” section for full details.
sections.changelog:
1.8.4

  • Compatibility with WordPress 7.0

1.8.3

  • Fix: plugin token verification now works on service stores (sites without WooCommerce). Previously, all REST routes — including the verification endpoint — were gated on WooCommerce being active, causing the dashboard’s “verify plugin” step to silently 404 for service-only sites.

1.8.1

  • Bugfix

1.8.0

  • Initial release
